docs.doc: AC31-AC34 definitions. DIN reads 4 spare inputs from MCP23017 #1. DOUT controls 8 outputs via shift register SR4 bits 32-39. Input debouncing applies TIMING_DEBOUNCE_MS.
Detailed AC with pin mappings. DIN0=GPA7, DIN1=GPB5, DIN2=GPB6, DIN3=GPB7. DOUT0-7 = SR4 Q0-Q7 (bits 32-39). FR35-FR36, FR41-FR42 coverage.
8 general purpose outputs via shift registers (SR4). MCP23017 spare inputs. I2C0 for expanders, SPI2 for shift registers.
Handler pattern reference: posok_handler.cpp. Error codes E035-E037 defined. Module placement in command_executor for command-driven features.

constraints.constraint: Header-Only Configuration: All configurable values MUST be defined in header files. No magic numbers in source code.
Dual-Core Separation: Core 0 handles communication and safety monitoring. Command handlers run on Core 0.
I2C Coordination: Spare inputs share MCP23017 #1 with ALARM_INPUT and InPos. Coordinate reads with safety_monitor.
MCP1 Pin Layout: GPA7=DIN0, GPB5=DIN1, GPB6=DIN2, GPB7=DIN3 (not contiguous bits)
SR4 Bit Layout: DOUT0-7 = bits 32-39 (SR_GP_OUT_0 through SR_GP_OUT_7)
Command Handler Pattern: Use CommandEntry structure with verb, handler function, allowed_states bitmask
Error Code Sequence: Next available error codes are E038 (ERR_INVALID_PIN), E039 (ERR_UNKNOWN_ALIAS)

interfaces.interface: esp_err_t sr_set_gp_output(uint8_t pin, bool level); // pin 0-7, updates shadow register
esp_err_t sr_update(void); // Latch shadow register to hardware via SPI
uint64_t sr_get_state(void); // Returns current 40-bit shadow register for query
esp_err_t mcp23017_read_port(mcp23017_handle_t handle, uint8_t port, uint8_t *value); // Read 8 bits from port A or B
esp_err_t cmd_executor_register(const CommandEntry* entry); // Register command handler
esp_err_t format_ok(char* buf, size_t len); // Format "OK" response
esp_err_t format_error(char* buf, size_t len, const char* code, const char* msg); // Format error response

tests.standards: Unit tests use ESP-IDF Unity framework. Mock hardware dependencies (MCP23017, shift register) for isolated testing. Integration tests use actual hardware. Test files follow test_*.c naming convention. Tests located in component test/ subdirectories.
